payload.claim: The module docstring says 'It charges the session to the task under its own phase,' but CONTEXT.md's Phase entry is 'A named stage in the cell pipeline: DIAGNOSE, IMPLEMENT, GATE ⇄ REPAIR, REVIEW, REBUT, PACKAGE' and explicitly carves out the analogous host-invoked attempt labels: 'A stack batch also labels attempts SPEC_REVIEW and SPEC_WRITING. Each is a host-invoked session before the cell, and neither is a stage of the cell pipeline.' COMMIT_REVIEW is the same kind of host-invoked, pre/post-cell attempt label (it never runs inside the task's own cell), so calling it 'its own phase' misstates the vocabulary's Phase term rather than describing it the way CONTEXT.md describes SPEC_REVIEW/SPEC_WRITING.
